basic_info.description: 1925 Pacific Avenue offers modern living with a classic backdrop. Enjoy your pour over coffee outside in the beautiful and serene private garden. Watching your four-legged friends chase butterflies on summer mornings will inspire you to Be Great! Work from home from the 3rdbedroom and catch up on laundry in between zoom meetings. As the sun sets, you can enjoy a nice glass of your favorite wine and cozy up next to the wood burning fireplace. Friends and family will absolutely love your indoor-outdoor living arrangement and memories will be made for many years to come.
